profile.headline: Software Engineer 2 at Bank of America

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop new features on an industry-leading social collaboration web application.
- Produce quality control test cases to insure successful implementation.
- Maintain the 3rd party extension registry micro-service utilized by all Jive customers.
- Guide others on resolution of customer-escalated software issues.

positions.title: Platform API Engineer
positions.description:
- Create REST services to support UI functionality surrounding page customization.
- Focus on resolving API and 3rd party extension related issues. 
- Act as the Support team’s primary resource for API and 3rd party extension related issues.

positions.title: Software Support Engineer II
positions.description:
- Work directly with source code to identify and resolve coding errors across the platform.
- Prepare and apply backports to repair coding errors within live customer sites.
- Responsible for resolving critical customer issues and escalations through collaboration with teams across company.

positions.title: Student Grader Job
positions.description:
- Critiqued and clarified student examinations and homework assignments. 
- Strengthened student understanding of CSS and HTML material. 
- Demonstrated proper web coding practices.
